wishes.title: Wish #1
wishes.text: May every single day of your 21st year be filled with love, laughter, and all the little moments that make life magical.

wishes.title: Wish #2
wishes.text: I wish you all the confidence in the world — because you are capable of absolutely anything you set your beautiful mind to.

wishes.title: Wish #3
wishes.text: May your smile never fade, your heart always be full, and your dreams always find a way to come true.

wishes.title: Wish #4
wishes.text: You deserve every good thing life has to offer — happiness, success, adventures, and a love that never stops growing.

wishes.title: Wish #5
wishes.text: I wish for you a year full of new beginnings — bold choices, beautiful surprises, and memories worth keeping forever.

wishes.title: Wish #6
wishes.text: 21 looks absolutely stunning on you. Here's to the woman you've become and everything you're still going to be.
